name: Client intake and onboarding
summary: One intake per engagement: enquiry, screening, form, document requests, agreement and kickoff, with a dated step at every stage and a reason when you decline.
description: A short pipeline for taking on a new client: reply within a day, screen for fit, send the intake form, collect documents, send the agreement, start. Regulated professions can record who verified identity and when, never the document itself. Not an e-signature, KYC or payment tool.

reply_to_enquiry.title: Reply to the enquiry
reply_to_enquiry.description: A new intake gets a reply Action due the next day.

chase_form.title: Chase the intake form
chase_form.description: Three days after the form is sent, a chase Action falls due.

chase_document.title: Chase the missing document
chase_document.description: When the needed-by date of an open document request is reached, a chase Action is created.

review_received_document.title: Review the received document
review_received_document.description: When a document is marked received, a review Action is due the next day.

chase_signature.title: Chase the signature
chase_signature.description: Seven days after the agreement is sent, a chase Action falls due.

decline_letter.title: Send the decline letter
decline_letter.description: A declined intake gets a letter Action due the next day. State that no engagement exists and name any approaching deadline.

kickoff_event.title: Put the kickoff in the calendar
kickoff_event.description: When the kickoff date is set, the event is written to the owner's calendar.

first_value_check.title: Check the first result
first_value_check.description: Fourteen days after onboarding, a check Action asks whether the client has seen a first result.

stalled_intake.title: Review the stalled intake
stalled_intake.description: An open intake that stayed in the same stage for 7 days gets a review Action.

intake_form_records.title: Create the client, contact and intake from the form
intake_form_records.description: A public intake form creates the client, the contact and an intake in the Enquiry stage.

intake_form_notice.title: Tell the owner about the new intake
intake_form_notice.description: The workspace owner is notified of every submission.

prompt.intro: Set up client intake in my Customermates workspace: one intake per engagement with nine stages, document requests, dated steps at every stage, a decline reason and optional identity, conflict and risk checks that record who checked and when.
questions: What do you sell, and who are your clients: companies, sole traders or individuals?
Which steps does a new client go through today, and which of the nine stages do you not need?
Is your profession regulated, so that identity, conflict or risk checks must be recorded? In which country?
Which documents do you always ask for, and where do you store them? Only a link is kept here.
Where do clients sign the agreement? It stays there, and the dates are kept here.
